Class LambdaAllocNode

java.lang.Object
qilin.core.pag.PagNode
qilin.core.pag.AllocNode
qilin.core.pag.LambdaAllocNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextElement, Numberable
public class LambdaAllocNode extends AllocNode
An allocation site standing in for the object a LambdaMetafactory-bootstrapped invokedynamic call site produces (a lambda or method reference). Unlike a plain AllocNode, its implementation is known statically: calls on it that answer the functional object dispatch straight to that implementation instead of through the (nonexistent) functional-interface vtable.
